name: Elridge Energy Holdings Berhad
overview: Elridge Energy 今年通过子公司 Lumeria Power 以 4500 万令吉收购、安装和调试六条一体化活性炭生产线，进入活性炭生产业务；同时 Bio Eneco 与 Berkana Power 签订每年约 10 万吨棕榈仁壳供应的谅解备忘录，原有与 PT Orion APAC Indonesia 及 JFE Shoji 的谅解备忘录年内无重大进展。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长 26.5%，净利润同比增长 78.5%。
overview_en: Elridge Energy, through its subsidiary Lumeria Power, is acquiring, installing and commissioning six integrated activated carbon production chains for RM45.0 million, entering the activated carbon production business; meanwhile Bio Eneco signed an MOU with Berkana Power for the supply of an estimated 100,000 metric tons of palm kernel shells annually, while the existing MOUs with PT Orion APAC Indonesia and JFE Shoji saw no material development during the year.

segments.name: 生物质燃料产品
segments.note: 今年签订新的棕榈仁壳供应谅解备忘录，原有谅解备忘录无重大进展。
segments.note_en: Signed a new palm kernel shell supply MOU this year, while existing MOUs saw no material development.

actions.text: 公司再次更新与 PT Orion APAC Indonesia 及 JFE Shoji Corporation 的谅解备忘录状态，均无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The Company again updated the status of its MOUs with PT Orion APAC Indonesia and JFE Shoji Corporation; there was no material development on both.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司更新与 PT Orion APAC Indonesia 及 JFE Shoji Corporation 的谅解备忘录状态，均无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The Company updated the status of its MOUs with PT Orion APAC Indonesia and JFE Shoji Corporation; there was no material development on both.

actions.text: Bio Eneco 与 Berkana Power Company Limited 签订谅解备忘录，供应约 100,000 公吨棕榈仁壳及/或 Green Gold Label 认证棕榈仁壳，每年分十批交付，自 2026 年起为期一年，可经双方同意续期。

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年通过子公司 Lumeria Power 收购六条一体化活性炭生产线，进入活性炭生产业务。
segments.note_en: This year, through subsidiary Lumeria Power, acquired six integrated activated carbon production chains, entering the activated carbon production business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Lumeria Power Sdn. Bhd. 接受 United Equipment Services (M) Sdn. Bhd. 的报价，以总现金代价 4500 万令吉收购、安装和调试六条一体化活性炭生产线。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Lumeria Power Sdn. Bhd. accepted the quotation from United Equipment Services (M) Sdn. Bhd.
